type_constraints.assertion: metricType in [L2, IP, COSINE, HAMMING, JACCARD, SUBSTRUCTURE, SUPERSTRUCTURE]

type_constraints.description: idType enum Int64/VarChar; invalid value rejected with message: idType can only be [Int64, VarChar], default: Int64
field dataType is case-sensitive; wrong case rejected with: data type X is invalid(case sensitive)
type_constraints.assertion: schema.fields[].dataType must match exact case-sensitive DataType string

type_constraints.description: params map values must be numeric (string->float64)
type_constraints.assertion: params is map<string, float64> numeric values only

type_constraints.description: id int64 serialization: header Accept-Type-Allow-Int64 true returns int64 ids as JSON numbers, default returns strings
type_constraints.assertion: Accept-Type-Allow-Int64 header controls int64 id JSON encoding (number vs string)

type_constraints.description: supported dataType strings: Int64, VarChar, FloatVector, BinaryVector, Bool, Float, Double, JSON, Array
type_constraints.assertion: dataType in [Int64, VarChar, FloatVector, BinaryVector, Bool, Float, Double, JSON, Array]

range_constraints.description: dimension required and non-zero; missing or 0 -> code 1802 with message: required parameters: [collectionName, dimension]
missing collectionName or vector -> code 1802, required parameters: [collectionName, vector]
range_constraints.assertion: collectionName and vector required; else code 1802

range_constraints.description: loadProgress is 0-100; >=100 means LoadStateLoaded; -1 on error
R2 消解：query limit 语义应与 search topk 一致（正值域 [1,16384]）；limit<=0 静默全量返回与 search 拒绝形成同参数两面语义矛盾（实测 008/vein_002 两链）
range_constraints.assertion: v2 entities/query limit >= 1 且 <= 16384，否则业务码拒绝（同 v1 topk）
range_constraints.source_url: go-func: handler_v2.go:565 (if httpReq.Limit > 0 静默丢弃) vs :879 (search 无条件 TopK=Limit)

state_constraints.description: v1-created collections force autoID=true -> explicit id in insert data fails code 1804 with message: fail to deal the insert data, error: invalid parameter[expected=][actual=set primary key but autoID == true]; insert without id succeeds (server generates id)
state_constraints.assertion: autoID==true AND explicit id in data -> code 1804

state_constraints.description: upsert on autoID collection rejected: cannot upsert an autoID collection
explicit schema: autoID default false -> client must supply PK in insert; contrast with v1 quick-create
state_constraints.assertion: v2 explicit schema autoID default == false (client supplies id)

state_constraints.description: collection auto-loaded after v1 quick-create (composite create->CreateIndex->LoadCollection); duplicate name -> already-exists error
state_constraints.assertion: after create success, load state becomes Loaded without explicit load call

state_constraints.description: search/query require Loaded state; release returns to NotLoad; state machine NotExist->NotLoad->Loading->Loaded
state_constraints.assertion: search on NotLoad collection -> error until Loaded

state_constraints.description: release returns collection to NotLoad; load is async (poll get_load_state)

behavioral_contracts.description: REST error model: business errors use HTTP 200 + nonzero body code
behavioral_contracts.scenario: any v1/v2 request with invalid param / missing collection / bad data
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: HTTP 200 with body code in {100 collection not found, 1802 missing/invalid params, 1804 invalid data}; only auth(401/403), timeout, unmatched-route(404) are non-200
new collection name appears in list; describe returns schema/indexes/load
name absent from list; describe -> code 100 collection not found

behavioral_contracts.description: v1 vs v2 semantic divergence: metricType default, PK policy, search arity
behavioral_contracts.scenario: same operation via v1 and v2
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: v1: default metric L2, autoID=true forced, search nq=1 single vector, consistency hard-coded Bounded; v2: quick-create default metric COSINE, explicit schema autoID=false (client supplies id), search data supports multiple vectors

behavioral_contracts.description: range search coupling: range_filter requires radius
behavioral_contracts.scenario: v1 search with params {range_filter: X} but no radius
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: rejected code 1802 invalid search params; with radius present both are honored as range search

behavioral_contracts.description: v1 consistency hard-coded Bounded, not a request parameter (2.3.x)
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: consistency level Bounded applied server-side (source lines 228, 852); cannot be overridden via REST request in 2.3.x

state_invariants.assertion: after successful create, collections/describe returns code 200 and name in list
after successful drop, describe -> code 100 collection not found
after inserting N rows, collections/get_stats data.rowCount == N

state_invariants.description: load state machine NotExist->NotLoad->Loading->Loaded; release returns NotLoad; search/query require Loaded [R2 消解 2026-08-22：v2 create 路径尾部无条件 LoadCollection（handler_v2.go:1165，quick/explicit 两分支汇合）= auto-load 例外；显式 load/release 语义仅约束 v1 路径与显式调用]
state_invariants.assertion: loadState in [NotLoad, Loading, Loaded]; after release loadState == NotLoad; search before Loaded fails
state_invariants.note_rework: contract self-conflict resolved: v2 create auto-load by-design (source-verified); semantic_load_state_07 behavior == amended contract

state_invariants.description: autoID=true collection: client PK in insert rejected; autoID=false: client must supply PK
state_invariants.assertion: autoID==true AND explicit id -> code 1804; autoID==false AND missing id -> error
